model.name: Assign-as-next-task action — owner-gated action unit records explicit next (overrides derived, single-sourced in resolver)
model.description: An ASSIGN-AS-NEXT-TASK action (action unit on the universalActionBar, on the task item like R40.10 approve/decline), OWNER-GATED (non-owner 403), that RECORDS the assignment as DATA (assignedNextBy/assignedNextAt, the R40.10 approvedBy/approvedAt pattern) so the pin's next slot is PROVABLE not remembered. EXPLICIT-assigned next OVERRIDES DERIVED next, single-sourced INSIDE resolveSprintPin (next = explicit-if-set ELSE derived, never in a view). Uniqueness: one task next, replaces previous, no collision with current/lastCompleted. @390 pixel, fail-loud on record failure. This is the SELECT mechanism for Tron's last/current/next (today next is derived-only; he wants to assign it). REUSE R40.10 owner-gated machinery + R40.5 action-unit pattern + the existing resolver — do NOT fork.
model.tronQuote: a task needs to have the actions for the action bar: assign as next task

discoverySource.note: Completes the loop Tron corrected the PO on ('last, current unfinished, next — you easily can select them'). Today the pin's next slot is DERIVED only; this is the mechanism to ASSIGN it from the task. DESIGN-REQUIRED: (4) explicit-overrides-derived single-sourced in resolveSprintPin — nobody builds a SECOND next-source. Ties R40.10 (owner-gated action + approvedBy/At) + R40.5 (action-unit) + R-C1 resolveSprintPin.

model.crossRefNote: REUSE (do not fork): R40.10 owner-gated action machinery + approvedBy/approvedAt data pattern; R40.5 action-unit de-dup; R-C1 resolveSprintPin as the single next-source (explicit-if-set ELSE derived).

acceptanceCriteria.text: ASSIGN-AS-NEXT-TASK is an ACTION UNIT on the universalActionBar (per R40.5 de-duplication — a real action unit, NOT a bespoke button), living ON the task item (like R40.10's approve/decline).
OWNER-GATED, non-owner => 403. Priority is Tron's call; nobody self-promotes their own work (same integrity argument as approve: if anyone can set next, next means nothing).

RECORDS the assignment as DATA on the unit (assignedNextBy / assignedNextAt) — the R40.10 approvedBy/approvedAt pattern — so the pin's next slot is PROVABLE not remembered (trustworthy after a rewind).

★ DESIGN-REQUIRED: EXPLICIT-ASSIGNED next OVERRIDES the DERIVED next, resolved in ONE place — next = explicit-if-set ELSE derived, decided INSIDE resolveSprintPin, NEVER in a view. No two-sources-of-one-truth (the disease killed this session: two depref builders / two marker counts / two fabricated-uuid figures).
UNIQUENESS: only ONE task can be next — assigning a new one REPLACES the previous (same 3-slot uniqueness the pin enforces); must NOT collide with current / lastCompleted.
@390 real-device PIXEL gate — the action must be reachable AND fireable on his phone.
FAIL-LOUD: if the assignment cannot be recorded, show an EXPLICIT error — never a silently-unchanged pin.
